why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 58 covers avenues N, N 1/2, O, O 1/2; sheet 59 covers O 1/2, P, P 1/2, Q. Ave O 1/2 is the only shared avenue, and it is printed vertically in the corridor on both plates ('AVENUE O 1/2' at sheet 58's east edge, at sheet 59's west edge). The address runs are exact complements across the same corridor: sheet 58's west frontage reads the even numbers 2704 2706 2708 2710 2712 2714 2716 2718 2720 2722 2724 2726 2728 for the 27th-28th block, then 2802 2804 south of 28th; sheet 59's east frontage reads the odd numbers 2703 2705 2707 2709 2711 2713 2715 2717 2719 2721 2723 2725 for the same 27th-28th block, then 2801 2803. The cross-street runs clinch it: 28th St ends ...1720 1722 1724 (north side) / 1719 1721 1723 (south side) on sheet 58 and resumes 1802 1804 1806 1808 / 1801 1803 1805 1807 on sheet 59, i.e. the 1700/1800 hundred-block break happens exactly at this avenue. One avenue west on sheet 58 is Ave O (faces 2016/2229) and one east on sheet 59 is Ave P (faces 1041/1252); neither is shared. Detection's candidates (58: 2731/1720/710; 59: 734/1750/2767) were discarded. Positions are the mid-line of the 70' corridor: sheet 58 faces x=3014 and x=3227 -> 3120; sheet 59 faces x=35 and x=247 -> 141.
